dashboard.shortcutsDescription: Mirrors the sidebar, so nothing appears here that navigation hides.

tasks.otherDescription: Handle these at your own pace.

tasks.cannotFindNext: I can't find the next step
tasks.feedbackRecorded: Feedback recorded; content is kept to a minimum.

journeys.description: Long flows across modules, such as registration to post-event choices, or introduction to relationship.
journeys.emptyMessage: Progress appears here once you join an activity or start getting to know someone.

search.label: Search content, services, tasks and help
search.placeholder: For example: registration, refund, data export

search.emptyMessage: Try different wording, or open the help center.

help.description: Help filtered to your identity and permissions.

matches.emptyMessage: Express interest in recommendations first; a match forms only when they choose you too.

detail.contactDescription: One-sided consent discloses nothing, and consent can be withdrawn at any time.

invitations.description: Introductions you sent and received. Decline reasons are visible only to you and authorised safety staff.

invitations.detailDescription: Accepting still requires separate consent before contact details are exchanged.
invitations.decideDescription: Declining never shows your reason to the other person.
invitations.declineReason: Decline reason (visible only to you and authorised safety staff)
invitations.confirmAccept: Accepting still requires separate consent before contact details are exchanged. Accept?
invitations.declineDone: Declined. Your reason is not shown to them.

likes.title: My likes
likes.description: One-sided likes are never notified and never reveal whether they chose you.
likes.confirmWithdraw: Withdraw this like before it becomes a match?
likes.withdrawn: Like withdrawn. No one-sided notification is sent.
likes.emptyMessage: They appear here once you express interest in a recommendation.

skips.title: Skipped
skips.description: Skip reasons stay private. People may reappear after the cooldown.

contact.title: Contact exchange
contact.description: A revocable access grant is created only after both people confirm separately.
contact.otherConsented: They have completed their own confirmation.
contact.otherPending: They have not confirmed yet, so nothing is disclosed.

contact.noVerified: You have no verified contact points yet.
contact.consentDone: Your choice is recorded. Nothing is disclosed until both sides agree.
contact.withdrawDone: Consent withdrawn and existing access revoked.
contact.revealFailed: Contact details could not be revealed

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: This profile belongs to your account. Your dating profile is a separate record with its own review.
profile.formDescription: Saving increments the version. Previous values are never silently overwritten.
profile.saved: Profile saved as a new version.
profile.contactBoundary: Contact points are encrypted separately, visible only to you, and are never exchanged just because a profile is public.

settings.title: Privacy settings
settings.description: Strict mode is on by default. No exposure switch overrides safety actions or the other person's choices.
settings.modeDescription: Strict mode tightens exposure platform-side and locks the individual switches.

modeHint.strict: Minimum exposure. Recommended when you are new.

settings.exposureDescription: Controls where other people can see you.
settings.searchable: Let platform users find me in search
settings.contactExchange: Allow contact exchange after a mutual choice and both confirmations
settings.strictLocked: Strict mode is on, so these switches are locked. Switch to balanced or custom to adjust them.
settings.aiDescription: AI may use only the data you allow here.
settings.aiHistory: Let AI use my service history
settings.saved: Privacy settings saved and permission caches invalidated.

consents.title: Consents
consents.description: Every consent is bound to a specific release you can inspect and withdraw.
consents.withdrawn: Consent withdrawn and propagated to dependent services.
consents.notWithdrawable: Required for the service, so it cannot be withdrawn on its own.
consents.emptyMessage: Anything needing your decision will appear here.
consents.boundary: External model training is never granted by default, and is never bundled with AI assistant or long-term memory consent.

requests.title: Data requests
requests.description: Export and erasure re-verify your password and run as an auditable, module-by-module process.
requests.inventoryDescription: See exactly what the platform holds before deciding anything else.
requests.exportDescription: The export is encrypted and delivered through a single-use link.
requests.exportDone: Export request verified. Background jobs will process it module by module.
requests.correctionDescription: Corrections are recorded; historical facts are never silently overwritten.
requests.correctionRequired: Fill in both the corrected value and the reason.
requests.erasureDescription: Generates an impact plan first. Active services and legal holds block execution.
requests.erasureBoundary: Erasure cannot be undone. Completed transactions and compliance records are retained for their statutory period.
requests.erasureConfirm: This generates an account erasure impact plan. Continue?
requests.emptyMessage: Exports, corrections and erasure requests you submit appear here.

memory.title: AI long-term memory
memory.description: Long-term memory is off by default. Model inferences are not confirmed facts and need your review.
memory.switchDescription: Turning it off stops both reads and writes; existing entries can be cleared too.
memory.clearConfirm: This deletes all long-term memory, vectors and cached references. Continue?
memory.cleared: Long-term memory, vectors and cached references cleared.
memory.itemsDescription: Entries awaiting review are not used until you approve them.
memory.emptyMessage: Once long-term memory is on, entries needing your review appear here.

membership.plansDescription: Benefits come from activated entitlements. No plan overrides safety, privacy or the other person's choices.
membership.accountDescription: Plan, benefits, usage and changes all come from the backend record.
membership.benefitsBoundary: Benefits reflect server-side activation and are not computed by this page.
membership.benefitsEmptyMessage: Free plans, or benefits not yet activated, show as empty.
membership.usageDescription: Consumed, reserved and remaining amounts for metered benefits.
membership.usageEmptyMessage: Your plan has no per-use benefits.
membership.manageDescription: Generate a preview first; only an explicit confirmation reaches the payment system.
membership.changeDescription: Benefits never take effect before confirmation.
membership.priceBoundary: Pricing is confirmed by a commerce quote. This page never calculates or promises an amount.
membership.changeConfirm: Only an explicit confirmation reaches the payment system, and benefits do not start early. Continue?
membership.changeConfirmed: Change request confirmed. Waiting for the commerce and entitlement receipts.
membership.hardConstraint: No plan overrides safety actions, privacy settings, blocks, or the other person's hard requirements.
membership.historyDescription: Past plans, sources and status changes.
membership.retention: Cancelling or expiring never deletes purchased content, completion records or history. Paid membership falls back to the free plan.
membership.entitlementBoundary: Membership benefits come from activated entitlements, provisioned by the payment receipt after a successful purchase.
membership.noneMessage: Have a look at what each plan includes.

safety.title: Safety center
safety.description: Reports, blocks, restrictions and appeals live here, and each is independent of the others.
safety.emergency: If you are in immediate physical danger, contact local emergency services or someone you trust first. VAV is not a substitute for police, medical or legal support.
safety.noContactTitle: You do not have to talk to them first
safety.noContact: You can block, revoke contact access and report confidentially right away. The reported person never sees your identity, description, evidence or case priority.
safety.canBlock: Block them immediately and stop further contact.
safety.canRevoke: Revoke any contact access you previously granted.
safety.canReport: File a confidential report for the safety team.
safety.signInFirst: Sign in to open the safety center
safety.privacyBoundary: Reports are visible only to authorised safety staff, never shown to the reported person, and never written to public logs.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Reports are handled confidentially. You can add evidence or withdraw one that has not been actioned.
reports.formDescription: The reported person never sees your identity, description or evidence.
reports.submittedWithBlock: Report submitted confidentially, and they have been blocked immediately.
reports.withdrawConfirm: Withdrawing stops the safety team from working on this report. Are you sure?
reports.evidenceDescription: Evidence is stored encrypted with an integrity check.
reports.evidenceRequired: Choose a report and enter the evidence.

blocks.title: Blocks
blocks.description: Blocking is your own protection, independent of reporting, and reversible at any time.
blocks.addDescription: Once blocked they cannot start any new contact with you.
blocks.userRequired: Enter the user ID to block.
blocks.unblockConfirm: Unblocking does not restore old introductions, mutual choices, contact grants or relationship journeys. Continue?
blocks.unblocked: Unblocked. Past access is not restored automatically.
blocks.boundary: Unblocking only restores the ability to make contact again. It never restores previous introductions, mutual choices or contact grants.

restrictions.title: Account restrictions
restrictions.description: If your account is restricted, the scope and your appeal route are explained here.

appeals.title: Appeals
appeals.description: Appeals are reviewed by someone who was not involved in the original decision.
appeals.formDescription: Explain specifically why you believe the decision was wrong.
appeals.reasonTooShort: The reason needs at least 10 characters.

dating.title: Dating profile
dating.description: Your profile starts in strict privacy mode. Completeness reflects how much you filled in, nothing about you as a person.
dating.emptyMessage: Create one and fill it in step by step, saving as you go. Age is derived by the backend from your protected date of birth.
dating.created: Dating profile created in strict privacy mode.
dating.nextStepDescription: Required fields must be filled before you can submit for review.
dating.allRequiredDone: All required fields are done — you can submit for review.
dating.privacyDefault: Contact details are never disclosed automatically. Visibility is decided server-side on every query.
dating.editDescription: Fill in section by section. Each section saves on its own and completeness is recalculated by the backend.
dating.requiredForSubmission: Required before you can submit for review.
dating.sectionSaved: Section saved. Completeness recalculated by the backend.
dating.noFieldsMessage: Fields appear once the profile schema version provides them.
dating.narrativeBoundary: Do not include phone numbers, emails, messaging IDs or off-platform links — that content is rejected.

narrativeHints.self_introduction: At least 80 characters. No contact details.

dating.aiConfirmed: I confirm this is accurate and agree it is stored as my own statement
dating.narrativesSaved: Saved and queued for content review.

photos.description: Photos are shown to others only after human review.
photos.storage: Photos are stored privately, with EXIF stripped and the file re-encoded on upload. The platform runs no face recognition and builds no biometric templates.
photos.uploaded: Photo uploaded and awaiting human review.
photos.uploadedExif: Photo uploaded, EXIF stripped, awaiting human review.
photos.deleteConfirm: Deleting invalidates every access link immediately. Delete it?
photos.deleted: Photo deleted and access links invalidated.
photos.emptyMessage: A primary photo meaningfully improves your chance of being met.

preferences.allowRelaxation: Let the system relax non-hard criteria when there are too few candidates
preferences.saved: Preferences saved. Visible only to you and the recommendation engine.

privacyPage.description: Decide field by field who sees what.
privacyPage.boundary: Visibility is evaluated server-side on every query — the frontend never fetches the full profile and hides parts of it. Contact details are never disclosed automatically.
privacyPage.inPool: Allow my profile into the recommendation pool
privacyPage.fieldsDescription: Fields not listed default to private.
privacyPage.saved: Privacy settings saved. Recommendation projections rebuild immediately.

preview.introHidden: This context does not show your introduction.
preview.emptyMessage: Fill in and save some details first, then come back.

reviewPage.description: Once submitted, that version is frozen. Editing during review creates a new draft version.
reviewPage.defaultSummary: Completed the profile and submitted it for review.
reviewPage.submitDescription: Briefly describe what changed so reviewers know where to look.
